scenes.body_zh: 土力學設計幾乎所有計算都要回到有效應力。土係固–液–氣三相；強度用 Mohr-Coulomb；沉降同時間用固結；擋土用 Rankine/Coulomb；邊坡用安全係數同滑動面。
scenes.body_en: Almost all geotech design returns to effective stress, phase relations, Mohr-Coulomb strength, consolidation time, earth-pressure theories, and slope FS.

title.zh: 心智模型 1 — 有效應力

keyPoints: Water pressure is not 'extra load' only — it unloads the skeleton
scenes.body_zh: Terzaghi：有效應力 σ' = σ − u。剪切強度同壓縮性跟嘅係粒間有效應力，唔係總應力。水位上升 → u 升 → σ' 降 → 強度同剛度下降。
scenes.body_en: Terzaghi: σ' = σ − u. Strength and compressibility follow intergranular effective stress, not total stress alone.

title.zh: 心智模型 2 — 三相材料

keyPoints: e, n, S, w volume relations
scenes.body_zh: 孔隙比 e、孔隙率 n、飽和度 S、含水率 w 決定狀態。同一種砂，疏密同飽和度唔同，行為可以差好遠。
scenes.body_en: Void ratio, porosity, saturation, and water content define state; the same sand behaves very differently when loose/dense or dry/saturated.

title.zh: 心智模型 3 — Mohr-Coulomb 強度

keyPoints: c' and φ' from drained tests; undrained s_u often used for clay short-term
scenes.body_zh: 剪切破壞準則：τ_f = c' + σ'tanφ'。砂偏重 φ'；黏土短期常用不排水強度 s_u，長期仍回到有效應力參數。
scenes.body_en: Failure: τ_f = c' + σ'tanφ'. Sands are friction-dominated; clays often use s_u short-term and effective parameters long-term.

title.zh: 心智模型 4 — 固結係時間過程

keyPoints: Settlement rate depends on c_v and drainage path
scenes.body_zh: 外荷載先由水承擔（超孔隙水壓），再慢慢傳到土骨架。時間尺度由固結係數 c_v 同排水路徑長度控制——呢個係點解填海／堆載要等。
scenes.body_en: Load is first carried by water as excess u, then transferred to the skeleton as dissipation proceeds—time scale set by c_v and drainage path.

title.zh: 心智模型 5 — 邊坡：安全係數與機制

keyPoints: Water and layering change the critical mode
scenes.body_zh: 邊坡問題核心係找對失效面同機制，唔只報一個 FS 數字。雨水入滲、弱層、超孔壓可以令臨界面完全改變。
scenes.body_en: Slope safety is mechanism-first: the critical surface and water effects matter as much as the single FS number.

questions.prompt_zh: 水位上升但總應力大致不變時，有效應力同強度通常？
questions.prompt_en: If water table rises and total stress is roughly unchanged, effective stress and strength typically:
questions.explain_zh: u 升 → σ'=σ−u 降 → 摩擦強度項 σ'tanφ' 下降。
questions.explain_en: Higher u lowers σ'=σ−u and thus frictional strength.

questions.explain_zh: 強度由有效法向應力同 c'、φ' 決定。
questions.explain_en: Strength is governed by effective normal stress with c', φ'.

questions.prompt_zh: 一維固結方程中，c_v 變大代表？

options.zh: 超孔壓消散更快（其他條件相同）

questions.explain_zh: c_v 愈大，∂u/∂t 項響應愈快，固結愈快。
questions.explain_en: Higher coefficient of consolidation speeds dissipation for the same drainage path.

questions.prompt_zh: 邊坡穩定分析最容易犯嘅錯係？
questions.prompt_en: A common critical mistake in slope analysis is:

options.zh: 只報 FS、忽略係咪正確失效機制／弱層／水位
options.en: Reporting FS while missing the true mechanism, weak layer, or water condition

questions.explain_zh: 錯機制嘅高 FS 仍然不安全。
questions.explain_en: A high FS on the wrong mechanism is still unsafe.

title.zh: 互動：有效應力 σ' = σ − u

widget.formula: sigma_eff = sigma - u; tau_f = c + sigma_eff * tan(phi)
widget.note_zh: 當 u → σ，σ' → 0，摩擦強度消失（理想化示範）。
widget.note_en: As u approaches σ, σ'→0 and frictional strength vanishes (idealized demo).

scenes.learning_goal_zh: 親手睇到水位／孔壓點樣「卸走」骨架應力。
scenes.learning_goal_en: See how pore pressure unloads the soil skeleton.

scenes.brief_zh: 要喺深厚軟黏土上建路堤。業主想快填。請用有效應力 + 固結時間尺度，提出分階段填土同監測方案。
scenes.brief_en: Build an embankment on deep soft clay. Client wants speed. Propose staged filling and monitoring using effective stress and consolidation time scales.

tasks: 指出快速填土時超孔壓同不排水強度風險
說明點解「看起來填完」仍可能未固結完
提出分階段填土或排水改善（概念層）
定義至少兩項監測（例如沉降、孔壓）
寫出何時可以填下一層嘅工程準則（概念）

scenes.deliverable_zh: 一頁備忘：風險 → 機制（σ'、u、時間）→ 填土／排水策略 → 監測門檻
scenes.deliverable_en: One-page memo: Risk → mechanism (σ', u, time) → staging/drainage → monitoring gates
